target_customer: Radiologists, radiology practices and teleradiology providers
problem: Radiology reporting is slow and inconsistent; Synapsica offers AI-assisted automation of reading and reporting plus a cloud RIS and PACS.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI reporting tools for radiology (pricing not found)
product_category: Healthcare AI, radiology workflow and reporting

founders.name: Meenakshi Singh
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; BioSpectrum calls her CEO.

founders.name: Cherian Dr
founders.background_notes: Name appears this way on the YC page and may be truncated; may be a doctor, not stated.

competitors.name: Aidoc
competitors.what: AI triage of medical imaging, CE mark for pulmonary embolism and FDA clearance for brain hemorrhage
competitors.funding_then: $27M Series B led by Square Peg in April 2019, about $40M total

competitors.name: Qure.ai
competitors.what: AI reading of chest X-rays and head CT scans (qXR)
competitors.traction_then: screened over 600,000 people in 20 countries per a later summary
competitors.funding_then: $16M led by Sequoia India and MassMutual Ventures Southeast Asia, February 2020

technical_complexity.rationale: Clinical-grade AI on spine MRI, chest X-ray and CT head plus a cloud PACS needs annotated data, validation and regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Embedding in radiology workflows and accumulated reports can lock in users, but better funded rivals existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well-funded imaging AI firms already covered related wedges in 2019 and 2020; no source shows them copying Synapsica's spine reporting.

market_need_then: Radiologist shortages and reporting load in India and elsewhere drove AI radiology investment; both Aidoc and Qure.ai raised large rounds just before the batch.

brand_strength.rationale: Product names such as RADIOLens appear in directories, but no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Synapsica raised a 4.2 million dollar Series A in June 2021 from IvyCap Ventures and Endiya Partners after joining YC in Winter 2020, and sold AI radiology reporting tools. The YC directory lists it as inactive, but other listings show it as active with a GE Healthcare distribution partnership, so a shutdown is not established and the status conflict is unresolved. No cause of failure is found, so failure factors are empty. The regulatory moat tag is a weak guess from the product type and not sourced, so treat it lightly.
notes: synapsica.com returned HTTP 503 so the site was not read. The Series A is stated by BioSpectrum (opened, June 24, 2021) and by YourStory and others in search results (YourStory returned 403). CB Insights total of $4.36M over 3 rounds, others $4.2M to $4.81M; the earlier rounds are not found, so coverage is partial and rounds may be missing. YC status Inactive conflicts with Craft.co (Active) and a TheBioStartups page about a GE Healthcare partnership. Founders are from the YC page only; education and employers not found. The success factor is unsupported by a source and is the weakest tag.
